release_notes: Build 123 fixes Autopilot schedule replenishment so the target means future scheduled full quizzes, matching the Scheduled count shown in the app.
A 14-quiz target with 12 future scheduled quizzes now requests a two-quiz generation batch and lets the existing scheduler place them on the next free YouTube dates.
Past releases, Shorts, unscheduled records and quizzes that were not uploaded to YouTube no longer inflate the refill inventory.
Autopilot now confirms the batch pipeline actually started before applying its 20-minute duplicate-start cooldown.
Failed starts clear temporary batch and trusted-publishing requests so Autopilot can retry cleanly instead of silently waiting after a false launch.
